**Colombia: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,082,426 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 213,704 in 2023, compared with 91,643 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 79% higher than in 2019 (51,164). Applications in 2025 were 42% lower than in 2024 (156,681). In 2025, the leading destinations were United States (50,868; 56%), Spain (14,524; 16%), Germany (4,911; 5.4%). United States received 56% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 10% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 15%, across 60,889 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 34% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 7.4 percentage points lower than in 2024 (22%).
